caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, curving metal object that resembles a saw or blade with a jagged, serrated lower edge and two perpendicular handles. The blade is dark brown and rust-colored, giving it an aged or weathered appearance. The handle at the end of the blade is cylindrical, attached at an angle, and is colored in a darker brown with lighter areas indicating wear or wood grain. A secondary, shorter cylindrical handle protrudes perpendicularly from the upper edge of the blade near its midpoint and is similarly colored with a lighter tip. The background is plain and beige, leaving the object clearly isolated in the center of the composition.
